## Description

Applies fractional integration and Vector AutoRegressive (VAR) modeling on cointegrated asset baskets to exploit long-memory mean-reverting spread dynamics.

## Where it may fit

Cointegrated sector baskets, multi-asset statistical arbitrage with slow mean-reversion persistence.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Funds, Quantitative Equity Market-Neutral Desks.

## Required data

Historical price series of paired or basket assets, fractional differencing parameters ($d$).

## Caveats

Estimating fractional differencing parameter $d$ accurately requires sufficient historical depth.
